(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 carries a tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that is zinc plated, but the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 mm applies before or after plating. This matters because plating buildup can push the finished size out of tolerance and cause assembly interference. The designer should add a note clarifying whether the dimension is pre-plate or post-plate, or adjust the tolerance to allow for coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the 20±0.02 dimension is measured after plating, or widen the tolerance to account for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"TL-007","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 through hole (D24) is a precision locating feature but has no surface roughness callout. This matters because an H7 fit requires a controlled surface finish to function properly, especially when a plating process will add material to the bore. The designer should specify a maximum surface roughness value on this hole.","recommended_correction":"Add a surface roughness symbol and value (e.g., Ra 1.6 or finer) to the ⌀8 H7 hole."}]}
